doc.onClick: called when this chip is clicked
doc.label: text label for this chip
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this chip
doc.enabled: controls the enabled state of this chip. When `false`, this component will not respond to user input, and it will appear visually disabled and disabled to accessibility services.
doc.leadingIcon: optional icon at the start of the chip, preceding the [label] text
doc.trailingIcon: optional icon at the end of the chip
doc.shape: defines the shape of this chip's container, border (when [border] is not null), and shadow (when using [elevation])
doc.colors: [ChipColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this chip in different states. See [AssistChipDefaults.elevatedAssistChipColors].
doc.colors.containerColor: the container color of this chip when enabled
doc.colors.labelColor: the label color of this chip when enabled
doc.colors.leadingIconContentColor: the color of this chip's start icon when enabled
doc.colors.trailingIconContentColor: the color of this chip's end icon when enabled
doc.colors.disabledContainerColor: the container color of this chip when not enabled
doc.colors.disabledLabelColor: the label color of this chip when not enabled
doc.colors.disabledLeadingIconContentColor: the color of this chip's start icon when not enabled
doc.colors.disabledTrailingIconContentColor: the color of this chip's end icon when not enabled
doc.elevation: [ChipElevation] used to resolve the elevation for this chip in different states. This controls the size of the shadow below the chip. Additionally, when the container color is [ColorScheme.surface], this controls the amount of primary color applied as an overlay. See [AssistChipDefaults.elevatedAssistChipElevation].
doc.elevation.elevation: the elevation used when the [AssistChip] is has no other [Interaction]s
doc.elevation.pressedElevation: the elevation used when the chip is pressed.
doc.elevation.focusedElevation: the elevation used when the chip is focused
doc.elevation.hoveredElevation: the elevation used when the chip is hovered
doc.elevation.draggedElevation: the elevation used when the chip is dragged
doc.elevation.disabledElevation: the elevation used when the chip is not enabled
doc.border: the border to draw around the container of this chip
doc.interactionSource: an optional hoisted [MutableInteractionSource] for observing and emitting [Interaction]s for this chip. You can use this to change the chip's appearance or preview the chip in different states. Note that if `null` is provided, interactions will still happen internally.
